verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a low-level framework for developers to build their own agents. The evidence covers building blocks such as graphs, checkpointers, interrupts and streaming. Nothing shows a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can hand tasks to. The 'assistants' API endpoints on the Agent Server serve developer-built graphs, which makes them a developer building block rather than a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
